sources.title: Thanksgiving Travel Expected to Dip Slightly Compared to Last Year
AAA forecasts first drop in Thanksgiving travelers since 2023 as high costs cool demand
Gasoline and Diesel Fuel Update (week of Nov. 23, 2026)

scenes.title: 81.5M travel this week
scenes.sub: Slightly fewer than last year, the first dip since 2023.
scenes.sub_html: Slightly fewer than last year, the first dip since 2023.

lines.say: Eighty one point five million Americans are traveling for Thanksgiving this week.
lines.show: 81.5 million Americans are traveling for Thanksgiving this week.

lines.say: That's slightly fewer than last year, the first dip since twenty twenty three.
lines.show: That's slightly fewer than last year, the first dip since 2023.

lines.say: Almost ninety percent are driving. That's seventy two point nine million people.
lines.show: Almost 90% are driving. That's 72.9 million people.

lines.say: Five point nine six million are flying.

scenes.label: average roundtrip ticket
scenes.note: Domestic flights, up 17% from last year

lines.say: Flying costs more. The average domestic roundtrip is about eight hundred dollars, up seventeen percent.
lines.show: Flying costs more. The average domestic roundtrip is about $800, up 17%.

scenes.label: a gallon
scenes.note: Up 58¢ from a year ago (EIA, Nov. 23)

lines.say: Gas averages three sixty four a gallon, fifty eight cents more than a year ago.
lines.show: Gas averages $3.64 a gallon, 58 cents more than a year ago.

lines.say: In Texas, it's cheaper: about three oh three a gallon.
lines.show: In Texas, it's cheaper: about $3.03 a gallon.

lines.say: Heading back this weekend? On Saturday and Sunday, leave before eleven in the morning.
lines.show: Heading back this weekend? On Saturday and Sunday, leave before 11 in the morning.

lines.say: Sunday traffic is worst from noon to eight.
lines.show: Sunday traffic is worst from noon to 8.

scenes.takeaway: Trips cost more this year. Budget the ride before you book it.
